name: Agents use what the box already does
author: wizard
description: Every agent can look up what this box already does (transcription, reminders, scheduling, app jobs) with one tool, and an install of a known duplicate (Whisper, a speech model) is refused with the tool to use instead. Read by the Agent Service (server/capabilities.mjs, capability_guard.py) and the App Manager (wam/host_services.py: a healthy host voice service fills Voice and Transcription in wam slots). Nothing in the shell changes.
